diagnosis: G1 CE-included ViT retrain val_acc=0.5617 is a REAL honest-negative, NOT a wrapper/label bug

smoking_gun_arithmetic.explanation: WeightedRandomSampler balances 3 classes; model perfect on NOT_SPIRAL (1/3) + chance on CW-vs-ACW (half of 2/3) = 0.667
smoking_gun_arithmetic.conclusion: model learns spiral-vs-not-spiral PERFECTLY, is at PURE CHANCE on chirality

gz1.note: CLEAN GZ1 spirals also at CHANCE

per_source_val_eval.interpretation: both subsets ~0.5 and NEITHER agree nor anti-agree => scrambled/chance, NOT a systematic label flip; chirality feature never formed

ruled_out.label_noise: CE argmax labels are DECISIVE at catalog level: for confident spirals only 0.2% have |P_CW-P_ACW|<0.1; median margin 0.62
ruled_out.parity_convention_flip: MODEL-INDEPENDENT catalog cross-match: on 38617 galaxies present in BOTH GZ1-confident and CE-confident, CE label == GZ1 label at 0.9972 (confusion near-perfectly diagonal). CE and GZ1 share IDENTICAL chirality convention.
ruled_out.image_join_bug: CE crossmatch uses the SAME 3-arcsec KDTree as GZ1 (which yields 0.99 GZ1-only); GZ1-subset images and NS learn fine from the same gz_desi stream
ruled_out.optimization_config: identical optimizer/LR/model trained GZ1-only to 0.9931 (broke out at epoch 5 from the SAME 0.66/0.62 plateau); here train_acc ALSO stuck at 0.667 for 26 epochs so it cannot even FIT chirality on train => data, not LR

root_cause.summary: The 72% of spirals that are CE-only (matched CE but NOT GZ1-confident) are faint, small, LOW-CE-confidence galaxies whose chirality is not resolvable by a 224px-resized fine-tuned ViT. This near-coin-flip-quality supervision on 72% of spirals swamps the clean 28% GZ1 gradient and prevents the chirality feature from ever forming, collapsing chirality accuracy to chance for ALL spirals (GZ1 included).

ce_only_vs_gz1overlap.note: 99.72% CE<->GZ1 agreement holds only on the BRIGHT high-confidence overlap; the faint CE-only pool that dominates training has median CE confidence 0.569 (25th pctile 0.471, barely above the 0.4 admission threshold)

not_a_wrapper_bug: train_g1_manifest.build_dataset faithfully reproduces train_chirality_v2.py's assembly (same 0.4 CE threshold, same argmax label, same KDTree). No code line does other than intended. There is no legitimate non-goal-seeking fix; raising the CE confidence threshold would redefine the experiment (defeat the 'reproduce full historical 17,153 composition' purpose) and is forbidden number-chasing.
bearing_on_manuscript_DO_NOT_EDIT: The historical 93.69%/92.10% CE-included headline is NOT reproducible under honest, seeded, manifest-retained ingestion of the SAME composition + SAME code; the ViT collapses to chance-on-chirality (56% 3-class). This CORROBORATES the paper's existing disclosure (L938/L1620) that the historical CE realization is unrecoverable and that 'validation substantially measures agreement with the CE model.' The GZ1-only G1 retrain (99.31%, ce_resnet_present=false) remains the honest regenerable realization and should stand; the CE-included run should NOT be integrated as a reproduced science result.
